svg.title: Flyweight
svg.desc: Flyweight. Share the common, immutable part of many similar objects and keep only what differs in each one, to cut memory. Step 1, Every Tree holds it all: 100,000 Trees each keep a name, a colour and their own 2 KB icon: 207.2 MB, almost all of it copies. Step 2, Split shared from unique: Name, colour and icon move into 5 immutable TreeTypes; each Tree keeps x, y and a type reference. Step 3, Plant 100,000, create 5: Planting asks the factory each time: the first oak creates Oak, later oaks reuse it. 2.41 MB in all. Step 4, Rules, and where it hides: Shared means immutable: one write recolours every oak. Seen in interning, glyphs, GPU instancing.

g.text: 100,000 Trees each keep a name, a colour and their own 2 KB icon: 207.2 MB, almost all of it copies.
Name, colour and icon move into 5 immutable TreeTypes; each Tree keeps x, y and a type reference.
Planting asks the factory each time: the first oak creates Oak, later oaks reuse it. 2.41 MB in all.
Shared means immutable: one write recolours every oak. Seen in interning, glyphs, GPU instancing.
Icon bytes: 100,000 copies, only 5 different pictures
// a new 2 KB copy every time
x, y and a type reference
→ every oak on the map turns red
So: make TreeType immutable (readonly fields, Object.freeze)
207.2 MB: 100,000 × (2,048 + 24) bytes, and 98.8% of it is the same 5 icons, copied
Estimate: 2,048 bytes per icon and 24 per marker for x, y and one reference; headers and strings left out
get(species) returns the TreeType already in its map, or creates it once and keeps it
2.41 MB: 5 × 2,048 bytes + 100,000 × 24 bytes, 86× less than 207.2 MB
100,000 calls to get(), 5 creates: the other 99,995 return a TreeType that already exists
Equality: compare by value, not identity, unless identity is the point
Clean-up: unused types stay cached; evict them or hold them weakly
Seen in Java Integer.valueOf(), String.intern() · Python sys.intern() · glyphs in text layout · WebGL drawArraysInstanced() · container image layers
